6670ee28-f26d-4b61-b49c-d71149cd5a6e.title: Mieruko-chan
6670ee28-f26d-4b61-b49c-d71149cd5a6e.altTitle: The Girl Who Can See Them
6670ee28-f26d-4b61-b49c-d71149cd5a6e.description:
All of a sudden, Miko is able to see grotesque monsters all around her; but no one else can. Rather than trying to run away or face them, she instead musters all of her courage and… ignores them. Join in on her day-to-day life as she keeps up her best poker face despite the supernatural goings-on.
___

e4e2da95-1cd7-49e8-9197-b7419be2077b.title: Ore ni Trauma wo Ataeta Joshi-tachi ga Chirachira Mitekuru kedo, Zannen desuga Teokure desu
e4e2da95-1cd7-49e8-9197-b7419be2077b.altTitle: The Girls Who Traumatized Me Keep Glancing at Me, but Alas, It’s Too Late
e4e2da95-1cd7-49e8-9197-b7419be2077b.description: Kokonoe Yukito has always been unlucky when it comes to women. He was rejected by his childhood friend, which he thought they had mutual feelings for each other. His sister hates him. His mother neglected him. Due to all these trauma stacking with each other, his emotions were completely destroyed. When Yukito enters high school, the girls who inflicted these pain on him started to care for him...!?

b5e3b32e-5d96-4ebd-b37e-3caa0b258824.title: Kanzen Kaihi Healer no Kiseki

b5e3b32e-5d96-4ebd-b37e-3caa0b258824.description: A college student, Sakurai Hiroki was summoned to another world to defeat the Demon Lord. And since he got "Priest" as a job, his starting Recovery Stat was more than enough to heal any wounds, so he dumped all of his Stat Points into Evasion. In other words, he's aiming for an Evasion Healer who will never get hit by enemy attacks. But unfortunately, people in that world couldn't understand his ideal! The King got angry against him and labelled him as useless almost immediately!

40ef8839-b6fa-4b55-a47f-0d03b770bd01.description:
As a high school boy and light novel author, Sakuasa Tomonaga was pulling an all-nighter to meet his manuscript deadline when, out of nowhere, he accidentally summoned a "Demon of Sleep" who called herself Nerno Somniafall...?
A cozy, romantic comedy about a sleep demon helping a sleep-deprived high schooler get some rest!

fd17c8e2-ef55-4931-9ba7-94d6e834c050.title: Fudanshi Tenshi
fd17c8e2-ef55-4931-9ba7-94d6e834c050.description:
Isn't it the best when guys fall in love with each other? 

A boys' comedy featuring an unlikely duo: A high school boy who wants a girlfriend VS An angel who wants to make all men into BL! 

Fuwa Itaru, a high school student with zero romantic experience, was looking forward to meeting new friends and a future girlfriend as he started his new life, but he was depressed by the reality that high school life was different from what he had imagined. Suddenly, Remi Emonier, who calls herself a "super elite angel," appears and tries to shoot Cupid's arrow so that Itaru can find a romantice connection, but where does it land...? Only men!? -- The angel who descended upon Itaru was a BL-loving angel.

0b2beaa6-08df-44e5-a404-ecee109744fc.title: Candy♥Candy
0b2beaa6-08df-44e5-a404-ecee109744fc.description:
Read from Left to right.   
  
From Wikipedia:  
Candy Candy is primarily a love story. Candy's first love was a character named Anthony Brown, but the series is remembered by the majority of fans as a result of her heartbreaking separation from her true love and soul mate, Terence "Terry" Grantchester. A recurrent story arc in the series is the "Prince of the Hill", a mysterious boy Candy met as a child and never saw again. His identity is revealed in the last pages of the manga.  
  
---
**Won the 1st Kodansha Manga Award for Shojo in 1977**

Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media Komputindo as **Candy Candy**

37816dc3-20a5-44b7-a889-b245b85e036d.title: Ijimete Ijirarete
37816dc3-20a5-44b7-a889-b245b85e036d.description:
Himeri Shishido is a tough, popular delinquent girl with high confidence in her strength.
She spends her days harassing Ui Odagiri, an otaku girl in her class, with the excuse of just "playing around".
However, something unexpected will put them into a secret relationship!
May it be Violence? Or maybe a Master & Slave relationship? Anything can happen in this bullying love story!~

79dba6c7-cc1e-475c-971b-82898375d27b.title: Komen Fuufu
79dba6c7-cc1e-475c-971b-82898375d27b.description:
In a world where the supernatural blends in with regular life, there is an old Japanese house. Living there is a newlywed couple, a human man and a kitsune woman. What can disturb their happy life together… except for a man-eating sparrow?

The daily life between human and youkai is dangerous by day, but sweet by night!?

91ccce69-925a-4c75-abaa-716dd7e168de.altTitle: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua
91ccce69-925a-4c75-abaa-716dd7e168de.description: After being ambushed by the Demonic Cult, Goheon Dok and Hyeonjo, his close friend from Mount Hua, are cornered and on the verge of losing their lives. Before they're both killed, Hyeonjo hands Goheon the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of Mount Hua that causes Goheon to take possession of the body of Muhwi, an apprentice of Hyeonjo. Now, as a Senior Disciple of Mount Hua, Goheon Dok must fight to protect Mount Hua and fulfill his friend's dying wish.

68669554-88ef-43ac-966b-e41d56682290.title: Wangan Midnight
68669554-88ef-43ac-966b-e41d56682290.description: When high school student Akio Asakura loses a high speed race to a Porsche 911 Turbo known as “Blackbird,” he goes to a junkyard to find parts for his car – only to discover a blue first-generation Datsun Fairlady Z (S30), which he buys. Akio later discovers that not only is the Z tuned to 620 bhp, it’s had a dark history of unfortunate accidents with its previous owners. Making matters more complicated is the fact that the last owner shared the same name with Akio. With the “Devil Z,” Akio forms a new rivalry with the Blackbird and its driver Tatsuya Shima.

cf404ea0-03c4-4382-9f02-afd9a8f40cd1.title: Nani no Torie mo Nai Heibon na Ore ga Bijin Futago Shimai o Inochigake de Tasuketa Kekka, Jitsu wa Yandere datta ni Futari o Gachi Horesaseteshimatta Ken
cf404ea0-03c4-4382-9f02-afd9a8f40cd1.altTitle: I, an Ordinary Guy with No Redeeming Qualities, Risked My Life to Save Beautiful Twin Sisters, Only to Make the Secretly Yandere Duo Fall Madly in Love with Me
cf404ea0-03c4-4382-9f02-afd9a8f40cd1.description:
Yagami Ryoya, an ordinary high school boy with no particular redeeming qualities, saved the lives of the school's idol twin sisters from a violent thug. That was the beginning of their sweet yet abnormal "repayment"─.
Reona and Riona close the distance, affirming his every move and spoiling him to the absolute limit. However, their love is a "yandere" obsession that goes way beyond just being "super heavy"...!?
Dragging in his family, his environment, and everything else around him, the twin sisters completely seal off Ryoya's escape routes. They are undeniably cute, but there is nowhere to run. What will become of Ryoya's fate now that he is locked onto by a 100% pure desire for monopoly!?
Packed with lovey-dovey moments! An unpredictable romantic comedy where the protagonist gets completely tossed around, officially begins!

b8e88f44-8fe3-41b8-a391-335576f7ddcc.title: Buchigire Reijou wa Houfuku wo Chikaimashita. ~Madousho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tataki Tsubushimasu~
b8e88f44-8fe3-41b8-a391-335576f7ddcc.altTitle: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
b8e88f44-8fe3-41b8-a391-335576f7ddcc.description:
Lady Elizabeth has her engagement annulled at a party by the crown prince, whose heart has moved on to another young noblewoman. She is then imprisoned in the dungeon over unjust accusations, and learns she has been betrayed by the country to which she has devoted everything...

At the peak of her frustration, Elizabeth finally decides to defect, with a grimoire holding hidden and formidable powers in hand!! She begins her new life and trade with the help of Viscount Lucas from the neighbouring country. With a fierce desire for revenge against her home country in her heart.
